name: Sable Fix Core 1.7.0
body:
## v1.7.0 — Repair-all

- 🧹 **/sablefix repair-all dry|apply**: fix every problem file in one command — dry prints a per-file plan summary (files × dead slots), apply backs up each file individually then clears its dead slots; one locked/broken file does not abort the rest, and the summary reports ok/failed counts plus the backup directory
- 🗂️ help updated; jshell-verified aggregation logic

## 中文
- 🧹 **/sablefix repair-all dry|apply**：一条命令修复全部问题文件 — dry 汇总每文件死槽计划，apply 逐文件备份后清零；单个文件被占用/失败不中断其余文件，最后汇总成功/失败数与备份目录
